# Mercury

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Business-bank marketing: a dark hero on #171721, a light page on #fbfcfd, purple #5266eb pills, Arcadia Display headlines and Arcadia UI, 32px nav controls and a 40px login pill.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (marketing pages, the login boundary at app.mercury.com/login, and the public demo at demo.mercury.com/dashboard; no signup, KYC, payment, or account). Themes: light, dark.

Tokens and component notes for Mercury, the business bank at [mercury.com](https://mercury.com/). Captured **2026-11-19**. Desktop is 1440×900. Phone is 390×844. Public routes only: the marketing site, the sign-in boundary at `app.mercury.com/login`, and the public demo at `demo.mercury.com/dashboard`. Signed out the whole time. No email was typed. No account was opened. No password, passkey, KYC, payment, or dashboard action was submitted.

Mercury marketing is Next.js. Colour is a custom-property system on `:root` (`--color-neutral-base-*`, purple, beige, green, blue, orange, red) with semantic roles (`--background-*`, `--surface-*`, `--text-*`, `--border-*`) that theme classes restyle. The home hero paints `dark-neutral-theme`. Pages below the hero paint the light roles. Display is Arcadia Display. UI is Arcadia. The app login and the public demo paint Arcadia Text.

## Typography

No composite type styles in tokens.json; the README text below names the faces and sizes.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Arcadia is the marketing UI, variable weight 360 to 500, from the site's own woff2. Arcadia Display is the hero, variable weight 320 to 480. Tiempos Headline is a 400 serif used on some marketing lines. IBM Plex Mono is the mono. The login and the public demo paint Arcadia Text. None of the files are shipped. The tokens name the families and fall back to Arial, Georgia, and ui-monospace.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- The signed-in bank. `app.mercury.com/login` was photographed at rest and with the email field focused. Nothing was typed. Log in, Continue with passkey, Forgot password, and Open Account were not followed.
- Signup, KYC, payments, cards, and treasury. Open account on the marketing site points at `app.mercury.com/signup` and was not opened.
- The public demo. `demo.mercury.com/dashboard` is a published demo, labelled on the page as "Explore the Mercury Demo." It is not an account. Open account, Move money, and the task list were not followed. The name "Jane" and the balances are demo content.
- Support. `support.mercury.com` returned a Cloudflare challenge to the headless browser and was not captured.
- Pressed, disabled, error, loading, select, radio, switch, tooltip, dialog, toast, and table states. The public pages did not show them, and none were forced.
- The pricing annual switch. It is visible in [pricing-light-default](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png). It was not toggled, so the selected state is the one the page painted.
- Font files. Arcadia, Arcadia Display, Tiempos Headline, and IBM Plex Mono are named. The files are not in this package.
- Screenshots are 256-colour. Read colours from the tokens, not from the PNGs.
- `--spacing` is 1px. The control scale steps by 4. Both are declared.
- [components.md](components.md) is written by hand from the measured crops and [raw/components-computed.json](raw/components-computed.json). `tools/build_components_md.py` only checks that every crop it links exists, so a recapture does not update its values: compare them with the raw readings after one.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do paint the hero on the dark neutral and the page below it on the light page.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do set the hero in Arcadia Display at weight 480.** [type-display](components/crops/type-display.png)
- **Do use the purple fill for Open account.** [button-primary-default](components/crops/button-primary-default.png)
- **Do keep Log in as a ghost pill on the dark nav.** [button-ghost-default](components/crops/button-ghost-default.png)
- **Do keep the login submit as a pill on the light card.** [login-submit-default](components/crops/login-submit-default.png)
- **Don't invent a second brand colour for the primary button.** The measured fill is `#5266eb` on both the nav and the login submit. [login-card](components/crops/login-card.png)
- **Don't treat the demo dashboard as a signed-in account.** [demo-light-default](screenshots/demo-light-default.png)
- **Don't type into the email field or submit Log in.** [login-light-email-focus](screenshots/login-light-email-focus.png)
- **Don't ship the Arcadia files.** The family name is the token. [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Don't follow Open account into signup.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
